verdict.rationale: Gusto's Embedded Payroll API and docs cover company setup, employee tax configuration, compensation-adjacent flows (off-cycle pay, benefits), and even an official MCP server letting AI agents like Claude/Cursor call the API directly, which supports the 'agent-driven onboarding' idea. However, there is no single documented end-to-end 'create employee + compensation + tax' onboarding flow or explicit employee-creation endpoint citation — the pieces (company creation, tax info, benefits) are scattered across separate guides rather than shown as one orchestrated agent workflow. Missing for 10: an explicit employee-creation API endpoint doc, a compensation-setup endpoint doc, and a worked example of an agent completing the full onboarding sequence via the MCP server.
